sn47.28:1.2: Ekam antam nisinno-Anuruddham etad avoca || || 3. Katamesam āyasmā
sn47.28:1.3: Anuruddha dhammānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññatam patto ti || ||
sn47.28:1.4: Catunnaṃ āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññatam patto ||
sn47.28:2.2: Idhāham āvuso kāye kāyanupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhadomanassaṃ ||
sn47.28:2.5: Dhammesu dhammanupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.28:2.6: Imesaṃ khvāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahabhiññatam patto || || 5.
sn47.28:2.7: Imesaṃ ca panāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā sahassaṃ lokam abhijānāmīti || 1.
